```sql
WITH base AS (
    SELECT pv.product_id,
           ol.order_id,
           pv.id                    AS variant_id,
           sum(ol.quantity)         AS q,
           sum(ol.line_total_cents) AS r
      FROM order_lines ol
      JOIN orders o            ON o.id = ol.order_id
      JOIN product_variants pv ON pv.id = ol.variant_id::uuid
     WHERE o.tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s
       AND o.created_at >= %(from)s
       AND o.created_at <  %(to)s
       AND o.status IN ('paid', 'processing', 'shipped', 'delivered')
     GROUP BY pv.product_id, ol.order_id, pv.id
),
agg AS (
    SELECT product_id,
           sum(q)::bigint AS quantity,
           sum(r)         AS revenue_cents
      FROM base
     GROUP BY product_id
),
oc AS (
    SELECT product_id, count(*) AS order_count
      FROM (SELECT DISTINCT product_id, order_id FROM base) x
     GROUP BY product_id
),
vc AS (
    SELECT product_id, count(*) AS variant_count
      FROM (SELECT DISTINCT product_id, variant_id FROM base) y
     GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT p.id,
       p.sku,
       p.name,
       p.brand,
       p.currency,
       oc.order_count,
       a.quantity,
       a.revenue_cents,
       vc.variant_count
  FROM agg a
  JOIN oc         ON oc.product_id = a.product_id
  JOIN vc         ON vc.product_id = a.product_id
  JOIN products p ON p.id = a.product_id
 ORDER BY a.quantity DESC, a.revenue_cents DESC
 LIMIT %(limit)s
```

De twee `count(DISTINCT ...)` dwongen een brede sortering op `(p.id, o.id)` af, inclusief alle productkolommen, die naar disk uitweek. Nu wordt eerst smal gehashd op `(product, order, variant)`. Daarna worden de distinct-tellingen en sommen met hash-aggregaties berekend en worden de producten pas voor de ongeveer 1.751 resultaatgroepen erbij gejoind. Typen en waarden blijven gelijk: `quantity` wordt terug naar bigint gecast en de numeric-som van deelsommen is exact.
